videos.title: The State of AI in Software Development: Data from 400+ Orgs — Justin Reock, DX
videos.summary: Despite pouring millions into AI coding assistants expecting 10x leaps, hard data across 200,000 developers reveals median velocity gains sit at just 7.7%—with nobody hitting even 2x. This talk exposes why AI-generated code is triggering bloated pull requests and dropping deployment confidence when applied to the wrong parts of the development lifecycle. If you want the unvarnished, data-backed truth on where AI actually drives engineering ROI versus where it creates friction, this presentation is essential viewing.

videos.title: The Death of the Code Review: What the Data Actually Says — Laurie Voss, Arize AI
videos.summary: AI agents have unlocked a 740% surge in code generation, yet engineering teams are only shipping 30% more software because manual code review has become an impossible bottleneck. Blindly trusting green tests is a dangerous illusion, as AI code routinely passes automated test suites while introducing massive maintainability and security vulnerabilities under the hood. This talk delivers the roadmap for the next era of development: why you must stop reviewing individual pull requests and start engineering the automated rubrics, evaluation harnesses, and runtime observability systems that make AI code genuinely safe to ship.

timestamps.topic: The 741% Code Boom vs. 30% Ship Rate Bottleneck
